threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions and someone tells you to take the back alleys. Not a single street name is mentioned.
Heard a guy on the 59 last night ranting about how he’s never seen a rat in a tuxedo before. Brixton on a Saturday, I guess!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The unmistakable scent of grilled kebabs wafting from the corner stand while your neighbor’s cat makes itself at home on your balcony.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a tram stop where buskers compete for your attention while you wait for your ride—real Berlin multitasking.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART outages; a tourist waits cluelessly while we just sigh and pull out our phones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today packed so tight, a guy in a tuxedo was sandwiched between a street performer and a dog with a sweater. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume every bar serves tapas. In Gràcia, you'll find more craft cocktails than patatas bravas if you know where to look.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones asking for directions to La Sagrada Família while holding a paper map, oblivious to the metro stops nearby.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think you can catch a bus on a Sunday evening and actually make it on time. Good luck with that, mate.
Caught a glimpse of a street performer on the 33 last week, harmonica in hand, serenading a couple in the back. Not a bad way to ride home.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw a dad juggling three kids and a pizza box, all while arguing with the kebab guy about the best toppings.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can catch a live DJ mix at the local U-Bahn station here—just last week, I stumbled upon a banger while waiting for the tram on Sunday.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're from here if they can name the bus route that runs late night better than their gym schedule. It's a survival skill, not a choice.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a guy debating philosophy with the driver. Only in the Tenderloin does a bus stop feel like a community college lecture.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a hipster hub, but the real charm is in the quiet plazas where locals sip coffee and watch the world pass by.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they marvel at the metro's 'first' and 'last' service signs; locals know it’s just a daily headache.
